title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README and agent guides to learn Football Life is a luck-based career sim driven by weighted wheels, not a match engine. CLAUDE.md is the live invariant source for Math.random, hiddenStats, auth, and club/continental sync.

title: Lobby Entry
description: The game lobby lists authenticated sessions; opening a game loads the Squad Board pitch where empty formation slots navigate into draft careers.

title: Draft Wheel
description: Draft route loads DraftDrumScreen; useDraftDrum orchestrates setup spins while the weight calculator and spin-resolver power deterministic pools and the sole Math.random entry point.

title: Season Loop
description: CareerActionsPanel and useCompetitionFlow drive mid-career wheels into league tables, cup journeys, and season simulation that turn outcomes into apps, G/A, and awards.

title: Growth and Balance
description: Incremental balance update: core-growth-balance.md is the SoT for peak OVR rarity, soft-caps, and Development Score gates. growth-balance.ts shares effective gate/count/magnitude pools with the wheel; club-fit.ts sets apps from player↔club prestige fit; season-stat-rates.ts supplies position-aware G/A/CS rates; stats evolution applies deltas server-side.

title: Transfers
description: Transfer service picks a prestige-matched destination; useCareerStats accepts offers and must sync currentClub with currentContinentalCup in the same update.

title: Persistence and Actions
description: Thin Server Actions validate with Zod, check ownership, and delegate to services; Prisma CareerPlayer/GameSession models persist career truth across sessions.

title: Security Checklist
description: Optional hardening pass: production checklist, middleware session gate, Upstash rate limiting on actions, and RLS deny-all lockdown so PostgREST cannot leak career rows including hiddenStats.
